_note: The seven nights. Ratified curriculum figures — changing a night is a data edit, never a code change. Read by src/lib/homework.js.

_fields.mode: "lesson" runs the two passes in Tarea. "game" routes to the Juegos handoff — Thursday is built elsewhere and its row is here only so the week is complete.
_fields.new: Which slice of THIS week's group (gating.current) the night teaches: third-1 | thirds-1-2 | all | weakest-third. Thirds are cut at n/3 on the declared order, in thirdBounds() — one function, so the cut point can change.
_fields.cumulative: Which earlier group tops the night up: none | lastWeek | twoWeeksBack. Resolved by the structure row's declared `number` (number-1, number-2), NEVER by parsing an id. A group that is unpopulated, or ahead of current, contributes nothing and the night simply runs short.
_fields.items: The target size. On a taught-order night it sizes the cumulative top-up and the new pool is never cut below itself; on a shuffled night it is the draw size. A thin pool shortens the night — silently, always.
_fields.order: "taught" is declared order. "shuffled" is seeded on the group, the ISO week and the weekday, so a night looks the same each time it is opened and two consecutive nights never shuffle alike.
